Physical card photographed and independently verified upright via three co-oriented axes: the rank/suit corner index (10 of Spades reads correctly, not inverted), the handwritten annotation '/AS/GNOMON.0QQ/-' (written along the same axis as the corner index), and the artwork's own natural orientation (Thing 2, feet-down/hair-up). All three agree -- unlike the 🔱4♦️ card's two competing annotation axes, no ambiguity to resolve here. Notation precisely fits the concept this tier was built for: MAJOR fixed at 0 (same major version as the current 🔱4♦️/👽A♣️/📎8♣️ line), MINOR and PATCH both left as Q -- an umbrella over whichever parallel minor-version lines exist under major=0, not committed to any single one. Artwork depicts Thing 2 (Cat in the Hat) flying a kite -- a notable thematic resonance, not forced: Thing 1 and Thing 2 are canonically one of a simultaneously-active, near-identical pair released from the same box, echoing this tier's own defining shape (parallel minor lines under one major arc, trunk-status unresolved between them until later). Worth naming as resonance, not claiming as mechanism.
